notes.title: Wishlist Seraphim Slum's Sequel, Edenfall!
notes.notes:
Hi! It’s been a little while, but I hope you’ve been keeping well (and I hope that your playthrough of Seraphim Slum was everything you dreamt of!) We're still in the process of working on bug fixes for Seraphim Slum, but in the meantime, I have very exciting news... 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902290/Edenfall/][img]https://i.imgur.com/t92lFr1.png[/img][/url]

I'm so happy to announce that [b]Edenfall[/b], our prequel-slash-sequel to [b]Seraphim Slum[/b] is now live on Steam! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902290/Edenfall/?beta=1]You can wishlist the game now[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902290/Edenfall/

[i]You're Eden, an eldritch thing. You're in love with your angel Ezekiel. But Ezekiel is enamoured by the slum she is damned to and the angels stagnating in it.

She wants the slum angels to fall. You would do anything to help her. But she wants you, eldritch thing you are, to swallow up the slum as she dallies with its angels. She wants you away from her, wants to love something that is not you.

And that just can't do.

You must make Ezekiel love you. You must tell Ezekiel you love her. You may be a mass of vines and branches but you have a confession to make.

Somehow, you must find a way.

(Parchments, radios, songs… something pulsing alive. Ezekiel must hear it.)[/i]

Thank you all for reading and I hope you'll wishlist and play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902290/Edenfall/?beta=1]Edenfall[/url] when it comes out! I hope to see you in the slums once more, hopefully on Valentine’s Day. <3

Love,
rosesrot

(PS: I’ll be releasing a demo of Edenfall soon as well, so keep a lookout for that!)

(PPS: if you'd like to be posted on my future stories and games, sign up to my [url=https://mailchi.mp/497e35229ed3/5uxp1ctfvr]mailing list[/url] or join my [url=https://discord.com/invite/HqD3SueXC7]Discord[/url] and say hi! I’d love to chat with you guys.)

notes.title: A Seraphim's Guide To The Slum - Quick Fix!
notes.notes:
Hi! As you know, I've released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018350/Seraphim_Slum__A_Seraphims_Guide_To_The_Slum/]A Seraphim's Guide To The Slum[/url] not long ago, which is the companion book to Seraphim Slum. It's partly a guidebook, partly a director's commentary, and if you liked the game I do encourage you to get it! I promise it's worth your time.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018350/Seraphim_Slum__A_Seraphims_Guide_To_The_Slum/][img]https://i.imgur.com/7yAiHiX.png[/img][/url]

A few of you have reported to me an error in the Ideal Ending walkthrough for Oriel's Part 1 route, where I wrote in to pick a choice that wouldn't have progressed the Ideal Ending. The offending choice has been removed from the guidebook. My apologies for the confusion! 

(If you have picked the said offending choice during your run of Oriel Part 1, you can proceed as normal, post-crash — it doesn't affect your Ideal Ending run.)

You can get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018350/Seraphim_Slum__A_Seraphims_Guide_To_The_Slum/]A Seraphim's Guide To The Slum[/url] on:

notes.title: A Seraphim's Guide To The Slum - Out Now!
notes.notes:
I'm super excited to say that I've just released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018350/Seraphim_Slum__A_Seraphims_Guide_To_The_Slum/]A Seraphim's Guide To The Slum[/url]! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018350/Seraphim_Slum__A_Seraphims_Guide_To_The_Slum/][img]https://i.imgur.com/7yAiHiX.png[/img][/url]

In this book, you'll get 66 pages' worth of bonus content exclusive to this book: a detailed walkthrough to the four endings of [i]Seraphim Slum[/i]; a comprehensive director's commentary from me about the thesis and themes of the game's story, a character and story breakdown, and more! Everything you wanted to know about the story, its inspirations, its logic, and — as Ezekiel is so obsessive over — its [i]secrets[/i]... is right here :) 

Will you open it up?

If you liked Seraphim Slum, getting this book will let you support my ability to continue writing stories and making games for you to enjoy. Thank you so much! c:
